name: the-last-heart
description: The Last Heart — آخر قلب game platform monorepo

scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:workspace && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/contracts build && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/backend verify && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/admin-web verify && pnpm run test:tooling
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @thelastheart/backend test && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/admin-web test && pnpm run test:tooling
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @thelastheart/contracts build && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/backend build && pnpm --filter @thelastheart/admin-web build
